question_stem: An isolated stationary nucleus $Q$ decays into nucleus $R$ and an $\alpha$-particle. The $\alpha$-particle has speed $1.5 \times 10^7 \text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Complete the equation for this decay.

$${}_{88}Q \longrightarrow {}^{222}_{......}R + {}^{4}_{2}\alpha$$

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: By considering momentum, calculate the speed of nucleus $R$ after the decay.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: State **three** quantities that are conserved during the decay.
